description: This file defines the PermissionList class, which models a list of permissions including total count and the permission objects themselves. It implements Serializable and manages permissions via getter and setter methods.

classes.name: PermissionList
classes.description: A serializable class representing a list of permissions with a total count and methods to access and modify these properties.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of permissions.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of permissions.
